thesis: Ben Eifert defines volatility investing as strategies that isolate features of the probability distribution of returns rather than taking first-order directional exposure to the underlying market. He contrasts this with traditional option strategies like call overwriting or put selling, which he notes typically carry significant long equity market exposure where direction is the primary risk factor.
